businessContact.verification: WXCU's official homepage explicitly presents wxcuradio@capital.edu as the alternative contact for artists seeking to get original music played, and the official Contact page republishes the same address in plaintext. The address has valid syntax and uses Capital University's institutional capital.edu domain. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.

formBoundary.manualRecheckReason: The homepage states that a form appears below the invitation, but passive rendering does not expose the fields, upload/link controls, validation, consent, CAPTCHA or anti-spam state.

activityVerification.evidence: WXCU's official site exposes a live listening stream, a current 2026 management roster and current-semester station language. The management page names Colt Fyffe as Music Director and Studio Manager and states that he joined management in spring 2026; other current team biographies also reference 2026. The latest visible blog posts are dated November 9, 2025.

genreFitEvidence: WXCU is an open college-radio environment centered on music discovery and original artist airplay.
The current Music Director's role includes updating the station catalog.
The current management team's stated music interests span alternative rock, hip-hop, pop, indie and crossover music.
Selected MarcsMusic electronic, alternative, hip-hop-crossover and world-fusion releases have plausible fit, subject to the current form and Music Director review.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: WXCU explicitly authorizes original-music airplay submissions through its homepage form or published station mailbox, but passive rendering does not reveal the current form fields or delivery specifications. A human must reopen the official homepage, inspect the form and any CAPTCHA, anti-spam, validation or consent controls, confirm international and release eligibility, verify the requested upload, attachment or link method, check formats, file sizes, metadata, release timing, explicit-content and AI-origin rules, select one rights-cleared MarcsMusic release and submit through only one authorized route. Individual DJs, management members, social accounts and the postal address must not be used as parallel or substitute routes.

deduplication.repositoryEvidence: The complete open pull-request patch and repository code index were searched for WXCU, WXCU Radio, wxcuradio.com, wxcuradio@capital.edu, Capital University radio and the official airplay invitation. No prior music-submission-agent platform, runtime seed or queue record was found.
deduplication.consolidation: The first-party homepage form and the explicitly published station-email alternative are stored as one canonical WXCU opportunity. The queue requires choosing one route only; individual DJs, management contacts, social accounts and the postal address are excluded as parallel opportunities.

notes: One new free-first WXCU original-music airplay opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review. No form field, email, file, link or physical package was submitted.
